**Page**  
Title: *Search*  
URL: <https://escholarship.org/search?search_field=all&search_terms=Santa+Cruz&search_status=any>

**Evidence**  
The page is a search interface for the eScholarship repository.  
* It contains a breadcrumb *Main Menu → Campus Sites → UC Santa Cruz* (link: <https://escholarship.org/uc/ucsc>).  
* It displays a list of generic search results (titles such as “Randomly Generating Stereotypes…”, “The Suspension of Disbelief: California City 1955 – 1972”, etc.) with links to individual items, but none of the listed items correspond to a dissertation submitted to UC Santa Cruz between 2014‑2018.  
* No dissertation details, author name, spouse name, or acknowledgments section are present on this page.

**Coverage**  
None of the requested entities, dates, or conditions are covered on this page. The page only provides general navigation and a handful of unrelated thesis or article titles.

**Missing**  
* Name of the dissertation author.  
* Title of the dissertation.  
* Dissertation submission date (2014‑2018).  
* Confirmation of selection for the Louis Stokes Alliance Bridges to the Doctorate Cohort V.  
* Co‑authorship of a design study (2016‑2019).  
* Submission of an abstract to the American Physical Society (2016‑2020).  
* Any spouse name mentioned in acknowledgments.

**Next links**  
* UC Santa Cruz repository homepage: <https://escholarship.org/uc/ucsc> – could lead to a site‑wide search filtered for UC Santa Cruz dissertations.  
* Individual search result links (e.g., <https://escholarship.org/uc/item/3pp5k07f>) – however, these titles are not related to the dissertation of interest.  
* E‑Scholarship “Campus Sites” list – may provide a route to UC Santa Cruz's on‑campus repository.

**Expand**  
No. The current page contains no direct path to the missing facts. A targeted search on the UC Santa Cruz site or the dissertation repository would be required.
